title: Zephyr: drift watchdog timer
description: Implement drift watchdog for Zephyr C. Acceptance: Uses hardware timer efficiently.
close_reason: Blocked: Requires Zephyr state machine (project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.2.11.3) to be implemented first. The drift watchdog timer triggers the JOINED->DRIFT state transition via on_drift_warn(), but there is no CCP FSM in Zephyr yet (time_sync.c only has basic sync state, not the 4-state CcpFSM). Reopen after .3 is complete.
